evals.prompt: I have a folder called 'Lecture_Notes_export' with 20 PDF slide decks from my IS3150 Digital Marketing course. Can you create a 3-column cheatsheet called cheatsheet-lec.typ that covers all the lectures? Include formulas (CAC, LTV, ROAS, CTR), a funnel diagram, the Minto Pyramid, and exam-ready sentence templates at the end. Compile it to PDF.
evals.expected_output: A compiled multi-page PDF with color-coded sections, formula tables, visual diagrams, and exam sentences. The .typ file should compile without errors.

evals.prompt: I have this cheatsheet.typ file but it's too sparse — too much empty space and missing formulas. Can you compress it, add a master formula table, add visual diagrams (funnel, pyramid, flowchart), and make an index box so I can jump around when printed? Keep the same topics.
evals.expected_output: A denser, improved .typ file with added formula table, diagrams, index navigation, and no syntax errors after compilation.

evals.prompt: My CS3244 Machine Learning course has lecture slides in PDFs. I need a 2-column study guide with all the algorithms, complexity tables, decision trees for model selection, and a formula bank (entropy, gradient descent, accuracy, precision, recall, F1). Add exam answer templates for 'which model to choose' questions.
evals.expected_output: A compiled PDF with algorithm comparison tables, complexity notation, model-selection decision tree, formula bank, and generic answer frames for open-ended ML exam questions.
